title: ACL Show 0.2 — payload
description: Look up the AclEntry 0.2 a maintainer holds for one subject. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

subject.description: VID of the party whose entry is being looked up.

Response.title: ACL Show 0.2 — response payload
Response.description: The success response to an acl/show/0.2 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/acl/show/0.2#response.

entry.description: The looked-up AclEntry, or null if the subject is not in the ACL (or the querying party may not learn whether it is — see the specification).

redactedFields.description: Names of AclEntry members the maintainer omitted from `entry` (for example ['label'] or ['ext.vnd.example.hr']). A maintainer cannot redact `act`, `keys` or `capabilities` — they are REQUIRED on every entry — and SHOULD NOT redact `approve` or `approveCapabilities`, because a redacted one is indistinguishable from an absent one, which means none: the reader would be told the subject approves nothing.
